Keys.Name: Enabled
Keys.Description: Master switch for Dungeon Master narration.

Options: Pause - hidden modal until narration ends
Keys.Name: Mode
Keys.Description: How eligible flavor-text popups are presented.

Keys.Name: ReplaceEligiblePopups
Keys.Description: Replace eligible flavor popups with narration/subtitles. Turn off to keep the original popup too.

Keys.Name: MessageBoxTiming
Keys.Description: Timing for message boxes that remain visible. Interactive prompts are never locked.

Sections.Name: Narration
Sections.Description: Choose which world and system text the Dungeon Master reads.

Keys.Name: NarrateFlavorText
Keys.Description: Quest, event, and environmental flavor text. NPC dialogue remains excluded.

Keys.Name: NarrateTutorialMessages
Keys.Description: Tutorial prompts/pages.

Keys.Name: NarrateOpeningNarration
Keys.Description: Privateer's Hold opening narration.

Keys.Name: NarratePlayerStatusPopups
Keys.Description: I-key health, location, and date/status popups.

Keys.Name: NarrateLevelingInspiration
Keys.Description: Leveling Inspiration LVLUP quest messages.

Keys.Name: NarrateCharacterCreationQuestions
Keys.Description: Character-creation questionnaire and biography questions.

Keys.Name: NarrateCharacterCreationDescriptions
Keys.Description: Race, region, class, and related character-creation descriptions.

Keys.Name: NarrateHUDStatusMessages
Keys.Description: Selected meaningful HUD status/observation text. Combat rolls and mode toggles stay silent.

Keys.Name: NarrateClimatesCalories
Keys.Description: Optional Climates & Calories hunger/thirst/temperature status text.

Keys.Name: ObservationVoice
Keys.Description: Who speaks vanilla look/observation HUD text. Player routing requires Daggerfall Narrator - Player; otherwise Dungeon Master falls back to normal handling.

Sections.Name: Readables
Sections.Description: Reading behavior for text the player deliberately opens.

Keys.Name: Books
Keys.Description: Book narration mode.

Keys.Name: QuestNotes
Keys.Description: Quest note/letter/parchment narration mode.

Keys.Name: QuestLog
Keys.Description: Quest Journal narration mode.

Keys.Name: History
Keys.Description: Character History narration mode.

Sections.Name: Voice
Sections.Description: Choose the narrator voice. An exact Voice Override takes precedence over Accent/Gender/Delivery/Depth controls.

Keys.Name: VoiceOverride
Keys.Description: Optional exact Daggerfall Voice Engine voice ID (for example bm_fable or am_granite). Leave blank to use the customization controls.

Keys.Name: Accent
Keys.Description: Narrator accent family.

Keys.Name: Gender
Keys.Description: Narrator voice gender.

Keys.Name: Delivery
Keys.Description: General voice character. This selects a suitable installed Kokoro voice.

Keys.Name: Depth
Keys.Description: Voice depth. 50 is neutral; higher is deeper, lower is lighter.

Keys.Name: Speed
Keys.Description: Speech speed percentage.

Keys.Name: AudioStyle
Keys.Description: Kokoro post-processing style.

Keys.Name: Volume
Keys.Description: Narrator volume percentage.

Keys.Name: UseGameSoundVolume
Keys.Description: Scale with Daggerfall Unity's normal sound volume.

Keys.Name: AutoStartVoiceEngine
Keys.Description: Automatically launch the bundled Daggerfall Voice Engine when it is not already running.

Keys.Name: ShowSubtitles
Keys.Description: Show subtitles for flavor text and manual test narration.

Keys.Name: ShowNarratorLabel
Keys.Description: Prefix visible narrator subtitles with “Narrator:”. This label is never spoken by Kokoro.

Keys.Name: SubtitleStyle
Keys.Description: Classic modes use DFU's native pixel font.

Keys.Name: SubtitlePosition
Keys.Description: Subtitle position.

Keys.Name: SubtitleFontSize
Keys.Description: Modern font size; Classic maps this to pixel-font scale.

Sections.Name: Cache
Sections.Description: Runtime speech cache. VoicePack files are never deleted.

Keys.Name: AutoManageCache
Keys.Description: Automatically trim least-recently-used generated WAVs.

Keys.Name: MaxCacheSize
Keys.Description: Maximum generated speech cache size.

Keys.Name: CleanupOnStartup
Keys.Description: Check the cache shortly after game start.
